case.case: Case 11 (reduced work-zone speed): Shoulder closure on divided highway
case.narrative: This scenario matches CDOT Standard Plan S-630-1, Case 11: shoulder closure on a divided highway, with a reduced work-zone posted speed (55 → 30 mph) that does not match the Case 26/27 mandated step-down. Fines Double envelope applies per CO Supplement §2B.13 and S-630-1 Sheet 12.
case.narrative_2: The generated plan follows the same device layout as the reference case with spacing computed for 55 mph.

checks.detail: Required: True. Signs placed: 15 left, 15 right.
checks.label: Signs on both sides of divided highway

checks.detail: Work-zone speed reduced 55 → 30 mph (Δ25 mph). Required: 2 stepped sign installations per CO Supplement §2B.13(A) (max 15 mph per sign). Placed: 2.
checks.label: Speed reduction <= 15 mph per sign installation

fines_double.citation: CO Supplement Sec 2B.13 + S-630-1 Sheet 12 Fines Double Signing Notes

operational_notes.action: Install Fines Double signs no more than 4 hours before the start of the work day. Do not leave signs up overnight when work is not active.
Remove or cover Fines Double signs when work concludes; doubled fines apply only when workers or work activity are present in the zone.
Relocate the R2-10/R2-11 envelope to follow the actual work area as the project progresses; do not leave Fines Double signs in place beyond the active work zone.
Maintain a 250 ft minimum spacing between Fines Double signs (R2-10, R2-11, G20-5P/R2-6P assemblies) and other warning or regulatory signs. Engineer may adjust placement to satisfy this minimum.

flagger.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Chapter 6D (Flagger Control) and Chapter 6E (One-Lane, Two-Way Traffic Control).

spacing.in_taper_text: 55 mph -> 55 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals speed in feet)
spacing.on_tangent_text: 55 mph -> 110 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals 2x speed in feet)
spacing.tangent_count_text: 800 ft / 110 ft max spacing -> 9 cones at 100.0 ft intervals
spacing.taper_count_text: L/3 = 183.3 ft / 55 ft max spacing -> 5 drums at 45.8 ft intervals

taper.cdot_reference: CDOT S-630-1 Case 11 (right-shoulder closure on divided highway, reduced work-zone speed)
taper.formula_choice: Speed 55 mph >= 45 mph threshold -> using L = W x S
taper.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.08, Table 6B-3. Shoulder closures use L/3 per Sec 6B.08 (Table 6B-3).
